name: Nakedness
overview: Scripture reveals that nakedness originally was not a cause for shame, as seen in the innocence of Adam and Eve before the Fall when they were both naked and unashamed. However, after sin entered the world, their awareness of nakedness brought fear and shame, prompting them to cover themselves with fig leaves. The Bible also addresses nakedness in the context of holiness and respect, forbidding uncovering the nakedness of close relatives and instructing care around sacred spaces to avoid exposing nakedness. These passages highlight nakedness as both a physical reality and a symbol of human vulnerability and moral boundaries established by God.
